answer: Clone keys cannot borrow the river wind. A claimant locks 41.2 POA for one numbered anvil on the foundry wharf and must keep it live for a six-hour watch. Every 9 minutes the dock zephyr has to turn the loft vane chained to that anvil; the smith then stamps a time-punch into a tied ingot and photographs the serial against the berth plate within 22 seconds. A cellar of remote copies cannot spin the real vane or stand on that plank. A still vane or a late punch slashes 6.4 POA and hands the forge to the next wait-listed smith.
